words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: Technique `effects` list (`{"name": <Effect>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}`) attached by fight.py / FighterCompiler when layer >= unlock_layer, matching `design/stage6-staging/thien_xu/pending.json`.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts): a technique may carry passive arts, each a named Effect with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the passive art's Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
words.decision_reason: Already approved in thien_xu checkpoint (2026-11-27) and needed by ~20 owners. Both green-furnace-canon (d5 the-furnace-spills-over, L8) and empty-mountain-sutra (d5 the-empty-mountains-answer, L6) attach The Empty Mountain's Answer via `effects`; the runtime Effect itself lives in effects/thuy_vi.effects.json so tv-green-moss-mirror also runs it today.

words.name: heal-overflow
words.spec: In engine.py heal() (line 1592-1600) and fight.gd heal() (line 915-922), emit a separate event `heal_overflow` whenever `amount > max(0.0, got)` (i.e. `ov = amount - max(0.0, got) > 0`, covering both partial overshoots where `got > 0` and full-HP / heal_cap ticks where `got <= 0`), carrying `{amount: ov, share: ov / s.hp_max, source?}` (plus `s.cur_ev`). Keep `heal_restored` strictly gated on `got > 0`.
words.gdd_text: Effects rule 5, `heal_overflow`: raised when healing exceeds the target's missing health (`amount`: lost health, `share`: lost share of maximum health); `heal_restored` still fires only when health actually increases.
words.decision_reason: Verified against engine.py:1592-1600, fight.gd:915-922, and all heal_restored listeners across design/ and assets/data/combat_effects.json: emitting `heal_restored` on `got == 0` would trigger unscaled pulse-regen side effects every second at 100 % HP on `thorn-lullaby` (1.0 c free soul hit/s), `ebb-and-flow` (+2 Water stacks/s), `marrow-to-dew` (+1.5 % qi/s), and `swelling-tide-palm` (+1 Tide/s), and bypass `heal_cap` checks. Emitting a separate `heal_overflow` event (mirroring linh lực's `overflow` at engine.py:919) with `share = ov / hp_max` avoids every side effect, captures 100 %-HP heals, and makes `The Empty Mountain's Answer` scale-invariant across realms (used by thuy_vi's tv-green-moss-mirror, green-furnace-canon, empty-mountain-sutra, and thai_chi's tc-purple-lingzhi-gourd). Until serial step b01 builds `heal_overflow` and swaps in `pending.json`'s `effects` record, `effects/thuy_vi.effects.json` runs the partial-overshoot `heal_restored` approximation.

The Empty Mountain's Answer.rule: Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second. When the foe cannot evade or carries 5 or more of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.
The Empty Mountain's Answer.approx: Stores per 2.5 % max-HP overflow (`event.share`) and deals 0.2 c Chaos free hits per unit stored; `decay_share: 0.1` decays 10 %/s.

_checkpoint: 2026-11-27 Neon re-review: both words confirmed `build`. Serial step s6-serial-b01 builds `technique-effects` and `heal-overflow` (separate `heal_overflow` event in both engines, keeping `heal_restored` gated on `got > 0`), then swaps this file's `effects['The Empty Mountain's Answer']` into `effects/thuy_vi.effects.json`.
